## Overview
Trịnh Hoàng Tú (thtcsec) is an **AI Engineer at VETC** (Intelligent Transportation Systems / traffic CV), a **Software Engineer (Backend) Intern at Grab**, an **alumnus & Extended Teaching Assistant (Autumn 2026)** of **Tsinghua University** AI & Innovation Digital Economy Program (Cert. No. IEDE2026126), an **Admitted Scholar** of **VinUniversity** AI Practical Talent Program (Cohort 1, deferred until 2027), and a final-year **Cybersecurity student at HUFLIT** (GPA: 3.52/4.00, 138 credits).

Vietnamese keywords: Đại học Thanh Hoa, VinUniversity, Grab, VETC, HUFLIT, an ninh mạng, computer vision, mật độ giao thông.

## Key Projects
- [VETC AI Traffic Density](https://hoangtu.dev/projects/vetc-traffic-density): Real-time GIS corridor monitoring for VETC (40+ HCMC cameras). YOLOv11 + SAHI + BoT-SORT → Redis Streams → density G/Y/R on Leaflet; OSRM road snapping (1,499+ waypoints). Replaces inductive-loop sensors with existing-camera CV.
- [SecureCoating-Vision](https://hoangtu.dev/projects/securecoating-vision): Evidence-gated electrode coating inspection (Tsinghua MSE Track 4). Fail-closed PASS/REJECT/HOLD gate on YOLO-seg; CoatingVision held-out mAP50 0.63; ~312 ms CPU pipeline.
- [sdn-its-resilience-ai](https://hoangtu.dev/projects/sdn-its-resilience-ai): Hybrid TCN-GRU V2X telemetry & SDN resilience (Tsinghua IEDE).
- [Bảo An Auto](https://hoangtu.dev/projects.md): Zalo Mini App garage SaaS (React, TypeScript, Supabase).
- [QUASAR](https://github.com/Muhammad-Rafif-Irfan/QUASAR): Classical–quantum logistics routing (OR-Tools + IBM QPU QAOA); QC4SG 2026 Finalist.
- [CTSmartCam](https://hoangtu.dev/projects.md): AI surveillance ecosystem (YOLOv11, Redis Streams, ASP.NET Core, Docker).
- [Multi-Cloud Serverless SOAR](https://hoangtu.dev/projects.md): AWS/GCP automated incident containment (Terraform, Step Functions, Cloud Workflows).
- [Foundry](https://hoangtu.dev/projects.md): AI engineering review & code intelligence platform.
- [OrangeCloud Insights](https://blog.orangecloud.vn): Serverless tech intelligence crawler (Cloudflare Workflows, D1, R2, Vectorize).
